description:
Orion-Friedberg Union

version 0.8.5: Combat test release

An upcoming Faction mod introducing new Systems, Ships, Weapons and Missions

an issue currently affects several missions and will be fixed in the next patch

Current release only includes Ships, Weapons, Fighters, Missions and a Basic market for campaign accessability

Requires a new save for campaign access. Does not work with Nexerlin random sector. Compatability with other mods has not been tested

Download version 0.8.5

Requires LazyLib and MagicLib

Introduces 3 new Weapons, 1 new Hullmod spec, 3 new Fighter wings, 9 new Ships and 3 new Missions

To access the equipment in campaign, visit Argeus in the Arcadia system and open the special market tab there

Ships
Frigates

Argeus Class Frigate
A small fast frigate for scouting and skirmishing

Diomedes Class Electronic Warfare Frigate
A small frigate with strong sensors and EW equipment

Sithon Class Missile Frigate
A frigate carrying a poweful missile armament

Destroyers

Bellerophon Class Battlecarrier Destroyer
A versatile destroyer capable of mounting layouts that prioritize either it's guns or fighters

Asbolus Class Destroyer
A patrol destroyer making up for it'S light loadout with exceptional range

Cruisers

Telemachus Class Fast Missile Cruiser
A fast cruiser with a powerful strike loadout

Rhadamanthys Class Advanced Carrier
A logistically demanding carrier that boosts the performance of it's strikecraft to the maximum

Agamemnon Class Line Cruiser
A powerful defensive cruiser mounting a powerful builtin cannon

Capital Ships

Hector Class Battlecruiser
A Battlecruiser with strong firepower

Fighters

Feile Fighter Wing
A dependable fighter carrying machine guns and anti fighter rockets

Zange Fast Bomber Wing
A wing of fast moving bombers carrying a decently powerful but well guided energy damage torpedo

Fräse Advanced Interceptor Wing
A wing of exceptionally powerful Interceptors mounting a deadly anti-fighter machine gun and a phase skimmer

Weapons and Hullmods
Weapons

Hagel Rocket Launcher
A small missile launcher firing medium ranged unguided ballistic rockets

Hagel Rocket Pod
A medium rocket pod firing in larger bursts

Krater Cannon
A expensive but powerful high explosive small ballistic weapon

Hullmods

Bomber Command Center
Conveys the benefit of ECCM package to the strikecraft of a carrier

Credits

Ruddygreat, Vexlia and others

for helping with scripting

Quacken, Pyrophage, Toopok and many more

for Inspiration, Advice, Encouragement and Help with spriting and art in general

MiniDeth3 and more

for help with writing

The Starsector Community discord

For Ideas, Discussion, Criticism, Encouragement and more

Changelog
14.09.2024 V 0.8.5 patch

Added the approptiate libraries as requirements

Argeus class frigate:

Kinetic Converter changes:
Changed damage bonus 20% --> 35%
Added range bonus: 50%

Bellerophon class support battlecarrier:

Changed hull: 3500 --> 4250
Changed flux dissipation: 250 --> 350
Changed OP: 95 --> 105
Changed Shield efficiency: 1.0 --> 0.9

Hector class battlecruiser:

Changed hull: 11000 --> 13000

02.09.2025 V 0.8.4a patch

Sithon class missile frigate:

Changed OP: 45 --> 40
Changed Shield efficiency: 0.8 --> 0.9
Adjusted Variants

Bellerophon class support battlecarrier:

Changed armor: 550 --> 750

Rhadamanthys class carrier:

Changed DP : 24 --> 22
Changes to Advanced bay hullmod:
Added 15% increased fighter replacement rate

Hector class battlecruiser:

Fixed Variants appearing in missions
Changed Deployment Points: 50 --> 45
Added Builtin Armored weapon mounts
Changed Cr recovery rate: 2%/day --> 3%/day

12.08.2025 V 0.8.3 patch

Adjusted some descriptions

Zange Fast Bomber:

Added slight delay before launching missiles

Diomedes class frigate:

Adjusted shipsystem to encourage use by ai

Asbolus class destroyer:

Changed speed: 95 --> 80
Changed flux dissipation: 350 --> 300

Rhadamanthys class carrier:

Changes to Advanced bay hullmod:
Changed speed bonus: 15% --> 25%
Changed manouverability bonus: 25% --> 35%
Changed hull bonus: 20% --> 150 flat
Changed armor bonus: 20% --> 50 flat
Added EMP resistance

Hector class battlecruiser:

Changed ordenance points: 280 --> 325
Changed flux capacity: 15000 --> 20000
Adjusted autofit variants

06.08.2025 V 0.8.2 patch

Added blueprints for all items

Hector-class Battlecruiser
Changed Shipsystem: Burn Drive --> Plasma Jets
Changed Shield efficiency: 1.0 --> 0.8 (look, i don't really know how to balance stuff)

Bomber Command Center
Removed Smod penalty
Reduced cost: 15/20/40 --> 12/20/30

03.06.2025 V 0.8.1 patch

Hector-class Battlecruiser
Changed Shipsystem: Accelerated Ammo Feed --> Burn Drive
Changed Shield efficiency: 0.8 --> 1.0

Fixed some typos and formating mistakes

29.07.2025 V 0.8.0 Combat Release

Initial Release

discordPostHtml:
An upcoming faction mod adding:
-3 new Weapons
-1 new Hullmod spec
-3 new Fighter Wings
-9 new Ships
-3 new Missions

The current version only includes the combat layer content. Access in campaign happens via a special market tab on Argeus in the Arcadia system

An issue currently affects several missions and will be fixed soon.

Download: https://github.com/JulianBraunbeck/Starsector-Mod-Orion-Friedberg-Union/archive/refs/tags/V0.8.5.zip
Forum Post: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=33745.0
aiDescription: Adds a new faction featuring 9 ships, 3 weapons, 3 fighter wings, and 3 missions. Campaign access is granted by visiting a specific market in the Arcadia system. The current release includes ships, weapons, fighters, missions, and a basic market.
saveCompatibilityText: Requires a new save for campaign access.
